# Figure 6

    a.UMAPs of beige and white monocle trajectories on TSS data.  
    b.Violin plot of monocle3 pseudotime calculated for separate beige and white trajectories, separated by common clusters (see also Supp S7). 
    c. Alignment of beige vs white scRNAseq trajectories on key genes (method: g2g alignment on monocle3 pseuodtime)]
    d. Monocle trajectory with prog cols - white and beige trajectory overlayed
    e. RNA velocity arrows with prog cols - total analysis. 
    f. Violin prog colours beige vs white monocle/ RNA velocity / harmony (RNA velocity)
    g. TSS prog colours

## Setup

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
library(scater)
library(velociraptor)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r global_params}
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "figure6_early_adipogenic_trajectories"
i_am(file.path("figures", paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
```

```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)

#Time point/condition colours
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486", "#E31A1C")
names(pal) =  c("white.day3","white.day1","day0", "beige.day1","beige.day3")
pal_white = pal[3:1]
names(pal_white) = c("day0","day1","day3")

#progenitor colours
prog_cols = c("#DA1819","#691A93","#EBB400" , "#434D51","#00AED1","#3AAD00","#FF7F00")
prog_levels = c("p5","p4","p6","p3","p0","p1","p2")
names(prog_cols) = paste0("p", 0:(length(prog_levels)-1))
ps_cols = c(prog_cols, pal[2:1])
names(ps_cols) = c(names(prog_cols),"day1","day3")
```

# TSS level trajectories
```{r tss_setup}
module = "beige_vs_white"
dataname="tss_fastmnn"
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
clusters =   tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(13)
cluster_levels = as.character(c(7,11,1,10,3,8,9,0,5,6,2,4))
```
## Load 
### Master pseudotime
```{r}
meta= read.delim(here(odir, "monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
meta$time.progen_clusters = factor(meta$time.progen_clusters )
meta$initial_clusters = factor(meta$initial_clusters, levels = c(0:11))
meta$cond.time = factor(meta$cond.time, levels=c("white.day3","white.day1","asc.day0","beige.day1","beige.day3"))
table(meta$initial_clusters)
table(meta$cond.time)
```
### Subset summary
Ran monocle trajectory analysis 12x on random subsamples of the data (3300 cells or 50% of cells per condition, whichever was smaller)

```{r}
dns_meta = read.delim(here(odir, "subset_summary_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
mean_per_cluster = group_by(dns_meta, subset_no, initial_clusters, pscondition) %>% 
    summarise(mean_pseudotime= mean(monocle_pseudotime)) %>% 
    mutate(initial_clusters = factor(initial_clusters, levels=cluster_levels))
head(mean_per_cluster)
table(mean_per_cluster$subset_no)
```

```{r}
monoclew = readRDS(here(odir,"white_monocle_complete_analysis_umap.rds"))
monocleb = readRDS(here(odir,"beige_monocle_complete_analysis_umap.rds"))
table(monoclew$time.progen_clusters)
```


## A: UMAP TSS clusters

```{r Aumap_beige}
p=plot_cells(monocleb, color_cells_by = "initial_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.75,  alpha = 0.5,
             graph_label_size = 5)+ theme_hp +
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters, name="TSS clusters", labels=function(x)paste0("t",x))  +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size=3)))
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent' 
p
```


```{r Aumap_white}
p=plot_cells(monoclew, color_cells_by = "initial_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.75,  alpha = 0.5,
             graph_label_size = 5)+ theme_hp +
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters, name="TSS clusters", labels=function(x)paste0("t",x))  +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size=3)))
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent' 
p

```


## B: White vs beige violin
```{r Bwvb_violin}
mean_per_cluster$cluster.pscond = paste(mean_per_cluster$initial_clusters, sep=".",mean_per_cluster$pscondition)
ggplot(mean_per_cluster, aes(y=initial_clusters, fill=pscondition, x=mean_pseudotime))+
    geom_violin(data=meta, aes(x=monocle_pseudotime),scale="width") + 
    geom_boxplot(fill="transparent", position=position_dodge(0.9),
                 aes(group=cluster.pscond, colour="n=12 subsets")) +
     scale_fill_manual(values=c("#FF7F00","#1F78B4"), name="Pseudotime\ncalculated on",
                       guide=guide_legend(reverse=T)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values="black", name="Average\npseudotime") +
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cluster_levels),
                                                 label=function(x)paste0("t",x)) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL, y="TSS clusters") 
ggsave(here(fig_dir, "wvb_violin_with_variance.png"), width = 9, height = 8)
```

# Beige vs white

```{r bvw_setup}
module = "beige_vs_white"
dataname="bvw_fastmnn"
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
clusters =  MetBrewer::met.brewer("Redon", 12)
cluster_levels = as.character(c(8,3,11,9,6,0,7,10,1,2,5,4))
```

## Read seurat objects 
```{r}
sbs_white= readRDS(here(odir, "white_combined_pseudotime_seurat.rds"))
sbs_beige=   readRDS(here(odir, "beige_combined_pseudotime_seurat.rds"))
merged_obj <- merge(x = sbs_white, y = sbs_beige, add.cell.ids = c("white","beige"), merge.dr = F)
merged_obj
merged_obj$progen_clusters = factor(merged_obj$progen_clusters, levels=c(paste0("p",0:7),paste0("day",c(0,1,3))))
head(merged_obj@meta.data)

meta = read.delim( here(odir,"combined_pseudotime.tsv"))
meta$initial_clusters = factor(meta$initial_clusters, levels=cluster_levels)
meta$sample_or_progen_cluster = factor(meta$sample_or_progen_cluster, 
                                       levels=c(prog_levels, c("day0","white.day1", "beige.day1","white.day3","beige.day3")))
head(meta)
```

### read monocle object
```{r}
monoclew = readRDS(here(odir,"white_monocle_complete_analysis_umap.rds"))
monoclew$progen_clusters = paste0("p", monoclew$progen_clusters)
table(monoclew$time.progen_clusters)
```

## D: Monocle UMAP

```{r Dprogenitor_colours}

p=plot_cells(monoclew, color_cells_by = "time.progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.75,  alpha = 0.25,
             graph_label_size = 5)+ theme_hp +
    scale_colour_manual(values=ps_cols, name="Progenitor\ncluster\nor time", limits = c(names(prog_cols), "day1", "day3"))  +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size=5)))
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent' 
p
```

```{r Dmonocle_split}
filt = monoclew[, colData(monoclew)$time.progen_clusters %in% c(paste0("p", 0:6), "day1")]
p=plot_cells(filt, color_cells_by = "time.progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.25,
             label_roots=F)+ theme_hp +
    scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_white[2]), name="Progenitor\ncluster\nor time", )  +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size=3))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks =c(0,5,10))+
    facet_wrap(~time.progen_clusters, ncol = 4) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,10))
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent' 
p 
```

```{r}
rm(monoclew)
```

## E: RNA velocity
```{r}
velo = readRDS(here(odir, "dynamical_velocity_output.rds"))
sce = readRDS(here(odir, "dynamical_velocity_scexperiment.rds"))
velo
colnames(colData(velo))
colnames(colData(sce))
```


```{r}
embedded <- embedVelocity(reducedDim(sce, "UMAP"), velo)
dim(embedded)
grid.df <- gridVectors(sce, embedded, use.dimred = "UMAP", resolution=30)

head(grid.df)
dim(grid.df)
if (subset_data){pt_size=1} else{pt_size=0.2}
```

```{r E_RNAvelocity}
options(ggrastr.default.dpi=600)
plotReducedDim(sce, "UMAP",colour_by="time.progen_clusters", 
               rasterise=T, order_by = "time.progen_clusters",
               point_size=0.2,point_alpha=0.3) +
    geom_segment(data=grid.df, mapping=aes(x=start.V1, y=start.V2, 
        xend=end.V1, yend=end.V2, colour=NULL), arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.05, "inches")),
        ) +theme_hp+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_white))
```


```{r}
plotReducedDim(sce, "UMAP",colour_by="initial_clusters", rasterise=T, order_by="initial_clusters",point_size=0.2,point_alpha=0.3) +
    geom_segment(data=grid.df, mapping=aes(x=start.V1, y=start.V2, 
        xend=end.V1, yend=end.V2, colour=NULL), arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.05, "inches")),
        ) +theme_hp+
     scale_colour_manual(values=clusters)
```

```{r}
for (l in 1:12){
    one_cluster = rep("grey", 12)
    one_cluster[l] = clusters[l]
    p = plotReducedDim(sce, "UMAP",colour_by="initial_clusters", point_size=0.2,rasterise=T) +
    geom_segment(data=grid.df, mapping=aes(x=start.V1, y=start.V2, 
        xend=end.V1, yend=end.V2, colour=NULL), arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.05, "inches")),
        ) +theme_hp+
     scale_colour_manual(values=one_cluster) 
    print(p)
}

```

```{r}
plotVelocityStream(sce, embedded, use.dimred="UMAP", 
                   color_by = "initial_clusters",grid.resolution=30,
                   stream.L = 6,
                   arrow.angle = 20, arrow.length = 0.5, color.alpha=0.5) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters)

plotVelocityStream(sce, embedded, use.dimred="UMAP", 
                   color_by = "time.progen_clusters",grid.resolution=30,
                   stream.L = 6,
                   arrow.angle = 20, arrow.length = 0.5, color.alpha=0.5) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=ps_cols)
```



### Supp Separate the prog colours

```{r velo_split}
for (i in c(paste0("p",0:6),"day1","day3")){
    cat("\nSubsetting ",i,"\n")
    sbs_embeding = embedded[colData(sce)$time.progen_clusters == i,]
    sbs_sce = sce[,colData(sce)$time.progen_clusters == i]
    if (i %in% c("p4","p5")){resolution = 5}
    if (i %in% c("day1", "day3")){resolution = 30
    } else resolution = 15
    grid.df <- gridVectors(sbs_sce,
                           sbs_embeding, use.dimred = "UMAP", resolution=resolution)
    p= plotReducedDim(sce, "UMAP",colour_by="time.progen_clusters", point_size=1,rasterise=T) +
        geom_segment(data=grid.df, mapping=aes(x=start.V1, y=start.V2, 
            xend=end.V1, yend=end.V2, colour=NULL), arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.05, "inches")),
            ) +theme_hp+
      scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_white))
    print(p)

}
```

```{r}
rm(velo, embedded, sce)
```

## F:Progenitor colours Violin plot
```{r}
dns_meta = read.delim(here(odir, "subset_summary_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
table(dns_meta$orig.ident)
mean_per_cluster = group_by(dns_meta, subset_no, time.progen_clusters, pscondition) %>% 
    summarise(mean_pseudotime= mean(monocle_pseudotime)) %>% 
    mutate(time.progen_clusters = factor(time.progen_clusters, 
                                         levels=c(names(prog_cols), names(pal_white))))
head(mean_per_cluster)
table(mean_per_cluster$subset_no)
```


```{r Fbvw_prog_cols}
ps_cols = c(prog_cols, pal[1:2])
names(ps_cols) = c(names(prog_cols), "day1","day3")
ggplot(filter(meta, time.progen_clusters != "day0"), 
       aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width")+ geom_boxplot(data=mean_per_cluster, aes(x=mean_pseudotime), fill="transparent", colour="black") +
  #facet_grid(pscondition~.) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=ps_cols, name="identity", limits = names(ps_cols)) + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits=c(paste0("day",c(3,1)), rev(prog_levels))) + coord_cartesian(expand=F) +
    labs(y="Time // Progenitor cluster", x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL)
```

## G Velocity violin plot

To emphasis the day0-day1 progression we use a higher number of Highly variable genes, and downsample the time points so there's an even number of cells between them.  

```{r}
dataname = paste0(dataname, "_equal_time")
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
sce = readRDS(here(odir, "dynamical_velocity_scexperiment.rds"))
```


```{r Gvelo_violin}
velo_info = as_tibble(colData(sce))
head(velo_info)
ggplot(filter(velo_info, time.progen_clusters != "day0"), 
       aes(x=velocity_pseudotime, y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width")+ 
  #facet_grid(pscondition~.) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=ps_cols, name="identity", limits = names(ps_cols)) + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits=c(paste0("day",c(3,1)), rev(prog_levels))) + coord_cartesian(expand=F) +
    labs(y="Time // Progenitor cluster", x="Velocity pseudotime", title=NULL)

```
